title: fix(local): Family P0 race isolation, durable checkpoints and verified Delivery evidence
body:
## Family P0 continuation — 2026-10-16

**Draft; Merge/Deploy/Activation remain HOLD.** Current review HEAD: `60cc7bff06ae7daade7550a600484ac46d4eb78b`. CI code HEAD: `da18b335c41f93d7d3ace7386997ccd891572f59`. The final commit changes six evidence files only; GitHub compare confirms all executable blobs are identical. Prior audit and current main ancestry are preserved. PR #280/#284 are reused.

Fixed here: race-local corrupt-checkpoint isolation with the existing validator; expired FINAL deadline reporting without redispatch; durable verified SOURCE and frozen Intent before later work; freshly verified FINAL-only Actions Summary with content/time/FINAL SHA binding; original input/error preservation. These are independent code defects, not an invented explanation for six missing historical connector refusal responses.

**Validation: four GitHub checks PASS**, including [LOCAL ingress 206 PASS](https://github.com/b03la013-max/keibametrics-runtime/actions/runs/38889387686), [Correctness](https://github.com/b03la013-max/keibametrics-runtime/actions/runs/38889387607), [Execution guarantees](https://github.com/b03la013-max/keibametrics-runtime/actions/runs/38889387856) and [Scope ownership](https://github.com/b03la013-max/keibametrics-runtime/actions/runs/38889387464). Official discovery read 12 races for each day; the legacy CI FUTURE label is not new unknown-future LIVE acceptance.

[Review / stop conditions / rollback](https://github.com/b03la013-max/keibametrics-runtime/blob/60cc7bff06ae7daade7550a600484ac46d4eb78b/evidence/family_p0_20261016/REVIEW.md) · [Fixed 9-race metrics](https://github.com/b03la013-max/keibametrics-runtime/blob/60cc7bff06ae7daade7550a600484ac46d4eb78b/evidence/family_p0_20261016/fixed_denominator_metrics.json) · [Full 12-race registration coverage](https://github.com/b03la013-max/keibametrics-runtime/blob/60cc7bff06ae7daade7550a600484ac46d4eb78b/evidence/family_p0_20261016/day_registration_coverage.json).

| Reliability item | Audited state / limit |
|---|---|
| Official discovery and coverage | 12/12 planned; keys observed for R1/R2/R6/R9 only (4/12); autonomous approval R1 only |
| Per-race deadlines / duplicate prevention | Existing bounded claim and no-blind-redispatch retained; deadline and corrupt-race regression added |
| Crash resume | SOURCE and Intent published before later work; interruption during publication/ambiguous FORMAL still reconciles or HOLDs |
| Git conflicts | Existing strict persistence and scratch recovery reused and regression tested; no receipt/authority conflict auto-resolution |
| SOURCE retry | Existing health/control transport has bounded transient retries (4); preflight max3. Direct official SOURCE GET has no local retry loop. This candidate does not claim automatic recovery for every SOURCE failure or add blind signed-execution retries; transient-source LIVE recovery remains to be demonstrated |
| Cancelled/active runners | Existing source normalizer/Static owner retained; historical cancellation and invalid-universe regression PASS |
| Runtime / Signer | Existing Railway deployment healthy; gateway/bundle/engine/parameter PASS; unchanged |
| Immutable FINAL | Existing execution-store verification reused; no signed artifact/OOS changes |
| Failure / Delivery | Race first-stop and original report preserved; fresh verification failure withholds Summary; Summary write is not user-arrival receipt |

Retrospective fixed cohort: 9 races, 3 original canonical FINAL/result closed loops, 0 independently verified prestart user-arrival receipts (three unknown). Six original refusal causes remain UNKNOWN. Normal request wording is retained; current connector capabilities cannot guarantee new registration in standard chat. A future approved all-race plan and multiple unknown-future Delivery/recovery acceptance remain required. No new LIVE dispatch, production configuration change, purchase or paid OpenAI API call.

A single hourly fault-audit/Draft-repair task starts 20:45 JST. It cannot dispatch, merge, deploy, activate or expand scope; it is not a realtime delivery guarantee. Owner review must cover this exact candidate, stopping conditions and rollback; no independent human review is claimed.
